company.name: Stord
company.shortDescription: Stord provides commerce enablement software and logistics services for e-commerce and omnichannel brands.
company.description: Stord provides commerce enablement software and logistics services for e-commerce and omnichannel brands. The company offers order management, warehouse management, inventory planning, fulfillment, transportation, returns processing, and last-mile delivery solutions through an integrated platform. Its software tools help businesses manage inventory visibility, automate order routing, coordinate multichannel operations, and improve shipment tracking across supply chain networks. Stord also supports direct-to-consumer and business-to-business operations with fulfillment infrastructure and transportation services designed to connect digital commerce systems with physical logistics processes.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series F round raised $250,000,000, or 32.26% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,324,862 to $3,000,000,000, a 243.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 83 (-12 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-27).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
